effects.label: Burn
effects.description: Damages the recipient by a percentage of their MAX HP, once per tick, for the duration of the debuff. Creates a Damage Zone around the recipient, damaging any of their allies in the indicated radius by a percentage of their MAX HP every tick.The number of ticks per second increases with Skill Speed. This debuff can be stacked.

levels.text:
Attacks 8 enemies in a 5m radius around Hara, dealing 61 damage. Casts a [1% Burn] debuff on the targets, lasting 4s. The [Burn] ticks every 2s, damaging targets by 1% of their MAX HP per tick (up to 150% ATK). Also damages all of the target's allies in a 6m radius by 0.5% of their MAX HP per tick (up to 150% ATK).

bio: None can hold back the dancing flame. Hara, born sharing the spirit of a roaring volcano, was no exception – she could never bear the quiet life her Clan laid out for her. She left as soon as she could, to wander the breadth of Amara calming the spirits… or exacting revenge on their behalf.
